verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs say AI reviews flag issues and suggest fixes, and that suggested fixes can be applied in one click from the review page ("take suggestions in 1-click"). Agent-made changes are committed directly to the PR branch. This covers the core of the story, but the one-click apply is described mainly through the Graphite Chat flow rather than as suggested diffs embedded in review comments. missing for 10: explicit docs showing inline review comments that carry committable suggestion diffs (including from human reviewers), independent or hands-on corroboration of the one-click apply.
